svg.text: mcring v1 — PCB floorplan, TOP side
mcring v1 stage-1 board — 26.5 × 22.8 × 0.6 mm, 2 layers, r = 1.5 mm. Scale 18 px/mm. Front (camera) edge at the top of the page.
Seen from ABOVE. Bottom-side parts are ghosted (dashed) for reference.
FRONT — camera / FPC edge (toward the fingertip)
BACK — antenna / u.FL end (toward the wrist)

rect.title: FPC1 24-pin 0.5 mm FPC, bottom contact, flip-lock ZIF @ (2.50, 11.40) 4.0×16.0 mm, h=2.0 mm
TPAD1 touch landing 3×4 mm copper + compliant contact @ (8.10, 5.60) 3.0×4.0 mm, h=3.2 mm

svg.text: u.FL (position per datasheet) → flex antenna down the back wall
I/O pins on the front edge and both sides; none on the u.FL edge (pin positions: VERIFY vs. the Espressif footprint)
contacts face DOWN (bottom-contact, flip-lock ZIF); FPC enters from the front edge
4 × Pico-EZmate 78171-0002 headers (1.2 mm pitch, 1.55 mm mated) in the right strip: pigtails plug in from above, wires drop through the 2.4×1.1 edge notches
Top layer: module footprint + fan-out, FPC1 pads, SW1, D1/R7, C3, touch landing + GND hatch, 8 test pads,
the four Pico-EZmate headers in the right strip (vias down to the charger / DRV / amp); GND pour elsewhere.
Bottom layer: all small ICs/passives, the two bare pad pairs (BZ1, J2), DVP corridor, I²C, power cluster; GND pour.
Module GND pads → ≥ 9 vias to the bottom pour; the u.FL end needs no copper keep-out (no PCB antenna on the -1U).
